text:
jessie: Heads-up — attempting to publish py/ts SDK 0.12.5 to canary stalled with a signer mismatch on the wheel. CI shows one unrelated flaky but the artifact signature failed verification. deploy-bot posted a failure. anyone on call?

deploy-bot: publish job failed: `signer-verify: mismatch` on `redwood-sdk-0.12.5-py3-none-any.whl` — see logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/13892 :x:
```
ERROR: wheel signature verification failed
expected: 0xABCD1234
actual:   0x0000DEAD
```

alex: ugh. could be key rotation or a bad reupload. do we have a policy for hotpatch canaries? :thinking_face:

mike: quick mitigation — pin dist-tag `latest` back to 0.12.4 for both py and ts so downstream consumers keep stable behavior. then we can retry signing+publish in a quieter window.

tay: agree on pin. i'll update the release notes + post a short deprecation note for the old sync client callouts if we need to patch. i can also coordinate docs if we do a republish. :memo:

sam: i can re-sign and reupload the wheel. need to rotate the ephemeral signing key used by the publish runner — who has access to the current key in HashiCorp?

jessie: @release-manager do we want a full rollback plan or just a dist-tag pin? this is a signer mismatch so artifact could be corrupted — better to avoid consumers getting 0.12.5 until we verify.

release-manager: pin dist-tag first. rollback (yank) criteria: if canary consumers hit >0.5% errors or package installs fail, escalate to yank 0.12.5 from registries and open a postmortem. otherwise keep canary blocked. also notify legal/security if signatures look tampered.

alex: steps we agreed: 1) pin `latest` -> 0.12.4 (mike) 2) rotate ephemeral signing key + publish creds audit (sam + security) 3) attempt re-sign + republish to canary (sam) 4) run targeted canary smoke tests (devex) 5) only move dist-tag after green smoke and signatures verified.

mike: taking step 1 now. running: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.12.4 latest` and `twine upload --skip-existing ...` for py pin. reply when pinned.

deploy-bot: dist-tag update requested by mike — queued. will post status. :gear:

sam: starting key rotation request with infra. tagging @security for approval. i'll hold on republish until rotation completes.

tay: i'll draft a short blurb for the release notes and the docs sticky: add a note "DO NOT CONSUME 0.12.5 until signature verified" and a link to the smoke-runner dashboard.

jessie: if republish is blocked >2 hours, we trigger the rollback plan and open a hotpatch branch from 0.12.4 -> 0.12.6-hotfix with the security patch. prefer to avoid full yank unless installs fail.

alex: small nit — we should pin the TS package dist-tag separately from the npm published tag used by our CI students. confirm `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.12.4 stable` vs `latest` semantics. i'll coordinate the exact tag naming with mike.

mike: done for py: pinned wheel -> 0.12.4 as `latest`. npm hold queued — will use `stable` for now per alex. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: dist-tag update completed for py. npm update in progress.

release-manager: good. sam & security — keep us posted on rotation ETA. tay — finish blurb and i'll push a short announcement to #announcements once we confirm the republish.

sam: rotation approved, performing re-sign now. will push new artifact to canary and attach `signer:0xABCD1234` metadata.

jessie: thanks. when you push, please run `./scripts/smoke-runner --canary-packages redwood-sdk@0.12.5` and paste a summary here. if smoke passes and signatures verify, we'll shift `stable` to 0.12.5 after a 30m observation.

sam: republished to canary, signature verified locally. smoke-runner summary: `0 failures / 120 checks / 10m` — logs: https://ci.redwood.example/smoke/2871 :eyes:

mike: npm dist-tag updated to `stable -> 0.12.5` per the plan. waiting 30m observation window.

tay: blurb ready: "Temporary hold on 0.12.5 due to signature verification. 0.12.4 is currently pinned. 0.12.5 canary republished after key rotation — monitoring in progress. Do not pin to canary in prod."

release-manager: observation looks clean at 30m. shifting `latest` and announcing. will close thread and file a short postmortem with timeline + lessons (signing key expiry checks).

jessie: thanks everyone. follow-ups: - postmortem (release-manager) - add signer-verify step to pre-publish CI (devex) - docs blurb published (tay) - confirm automation for dist-tag pin on future publish failures (alex) :thumbsup:

mike: closing pin actions. ping me if anything regresses. :lock:

deploy-bot: thread closed by release-manager.
